stem.en: Silk was known in China from the Neolithic period. When did it become a major item of external trade?

text.en: Around 4000 BCE, in the Neolithic period

feedback.en: Silk was known then, but the book does not say it was traded outside China at that time.
Silk was an important craft in the Bronze Age, but the book dates the big external trade much later.

text.en: Around the 2nd century BCE, under the Han

feedback.en: That is when work on the Great Wall ended. The silk trade is far older.

explanation.en: Silk is very old in China. It became a major export around the 2nd century BCE, during the Han dynasty, and the trade route took its name.

hints.en: The route takes its name from this trade.
Which dynasty ruled in the 2nd century BCE?
